source_binary_correspondence: The current source project's application ID, version name, and version code match the audited APK. The snapshot commit is later than the APK release and includes a developer-contact update. No reproducible-build attestation proves that the exact APK was built from this exact source commit.
privacy_notes: The production manifest requests zero permissions, including no INTERNET permission.
There are no runtime library dependencies, analytics SDKs, ads, accounts, WebViews, network services, or cloud sync.
Vault data is stored in Android no-backup private storage with additional Android Keystore encryption.
Manual encrypted export is user-initiated; an external document provider may upload the encrypted backup if the user selects a cloud destination.
Clipboard expiry is best effort and cannot control keyboards or other apps.
